_about: Photographs of the five monuments, from Wikimedia Commons under free licences. One entry per pilot_key. 'caption' is AUTHORED by the game team (what the photo shows, in plain words) and needs review; author, licence and source come from the Commons page of each file, checked on 12 October 2026. The licences ask for the author's name, the licence and a note of changes wherever a photo is shown: the game shows them under each photo and in its photo credits, and the README lists them. Share-alike photos stay under their own licence. To replace a photo: put the new files here, update this entry from its Commons page, and rerun tools/build_game_data.py (it refuses a photo without an author, a licence and a source).
